apps.name: Nuvio Enhanced
apps.subtitle: Unofficial Nuvio Mobile repository to build Nuvio with experimental features, improvements, and bug fixes not yet availabe in the official repository
apps.localizedDescription:
Unofficial. This fork is not affiliated with or supported by the Nuvio team. Please report bugs you find here to this repository, not upstream — unless you can reproduce them on an official build too.

What Enhanced adds:

Everything below is added on top of upstream Nuvio Mobile. Features that upstream has since adopted are dropped from this list.

Live TV:

Upstream Nuvio has no Live TV. This fork adds the whole feature.

Performance:

• Faster startup (Android) — saved data is loaded in the background while the splash screen is up.
• Instant home — the last home screen is saved per profile and shown on the next launch while fresh rows load.
